```text
# #2799: Patch: card animations for the Training Grounds set
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

This part fills in the Training Grounds set's card animation table, `apps/web/src/fx/cards/traininggrounds.json5` (#2784), for #2782.

Training Grounds has 60 cards (`traininggrounds-001` to `-060`) and 1 token:

- 28 are Spells, Field Spells, Traps or Field Traps; 6 of them are Field Spells.
- 22 are Units with a Cry, Death, trigger or Activate in their text.
- Its 20 Legacy cards are being redrawn in the yard's art style (#2724). Keep their motifs in that same style.

Read `docs/polish/9-card-animations.md` and the "A task over every card" section of `docs/issues-and-patches.md` first. This is a pass over every card.

### The measure

- **Spells and Traps:** every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap gets a motif, or a bespoke key, on its `cast` hook.
- **Units with hooks:** every Unit whose Cry, Death, trigger or Activate changes the board gets a motif on that hook.
- **Field Spells:** every Field Spell also gets an `aura` entry.
- **Vanilla Units:** a vanilla Unit may be `"none: vanilla"`.
- **How to pick:**
  - Pick from `cargo jackioh fx census` (#2788), never by comparing card texts, and give a reason for any override.
  - Use sub-looks (#2792) where cards blur together.
  - Scale by cost and rarity.
- **Floor:** this set has fewer Spells than most (28 of 60), so its Units carry more of the 55% floor.
- **Bespoke:** 3 to 6 Flourishes built from motif primitives, each with a one-line reason.
- **Legendary and Mythic entrances:** #2722's entrance and takeover animations are open to change (#2782); the owner finds them weak. A Legendary's or Mythic's Flourish may restyle its own entrance, and a Mythic its own takeover look, where the shared one doesn't suit the card. Do it through this set's table and its `fx/cards/<set>/` recipes; the shared takeover and the shared Legendary entrance in `fx/takeover.ts` are #2803's to rework. Keep the music (R2722000), when and for whom an entrance plays (R2722002) and the one capped hold (R2722001, as #2785 generalizes it). Update the tests that pin what you change, and amend R2722001 in this part's ruling note.
- **New motifs:** add one by the doc's rule if 3 or more cards fit none.
- **Set-piece candidates:** list them in the PR.

### The deliverable

A table in the PR with one row per Training Grounds card, giving:

- its id and name;
- each hook's motif, palette and scale, or its key or `none` reason;
- the census suggestion;
- why.

## Acceptance

- [ ] At least 55% of the set's 60 cards (33 or more) have an entry other than `none`, and every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap has a `cast` entry. A per-set test enforces this.
- [ ] Every Field Spell has an `aura` entry.
- [ ] There are 3 to 6 bespoke Flourishes, each with a vitest and an R200 check.
- [ ] The PR's per-card table covers all 60 cards.
- [ ] No hidden card keys an entry (R202).
- [ ] The `/dev/fx` gallery plays every entry.
- [ ] Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
- [ ] Web typecheck, tests and eslint pass, and the hotseat smoke settles.

## Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #2786, #2788, #2783 and #2792. Part of #2782.
```
